title: Products
subtitle: Register the products you sell and the price range used to validate sale amounts.

help.rule: An amount within [minimum, maximum] is used as is; outside the range or missing, the sale uses the default amount.
help.outOfRange: Out of range: the sale uses the default amount, {value}.

errors.name: The name must have 2 to 255 characters
errors.range: The maximum price must be greater than or equal to the minimum
errors.fallback: The default amount must be greater than zero
errors.generic: The action could not be completed.

deleteBody: The product "{name}" will be deleted and its sales will have no product. This cannot be undone.
